question: Where should deities and others be arranged for the kūṭa-cells?
premises: In the neck part is indicated.
Deities and so on should be arranged there.
inference: In the neck part of the kūṭa-cells, deities and others should be arranged.
uncertainties: Which specific deities are meant by devatādyā is not listed here.
plain_english: In the neck part of the kūṭa-cells, deities and others should be arranged.
